text:
alex: Quick sync - we're going live with the marketplace listing for APAC next Monday. Need owners for press, blog, microsite swap, SI badges, and HW legal gating. Who picks what?

mina: I'll own press + blog. Drafts in Drive: https://drive.google.com/marketplace/apac-v4. Need partner quotes from SI-Prime + SI-Delta. Will add UTMs.

hugo: I'll take microsite swap and CDN steps. Cutover plan: flip feature flag, run CDN invalidation, smoke checks. Dry-run in staging tomorrow.

sara: I'll handle partner legal / asset approvals. One HW partner flagged usage limits (hero web only). If not signed, we'll fallback to a placeholder card.

launch-bot: Scheduled job mc-2026-08-02 queued. Steps = asset check -> flag flip -> CDN purge -> smoke. Maintenance window at 6501239000 blocks releases.

alex: Timing idea: embargo lift 08:30 PT -> blog 08:50 PT -> microsite swap 09:00 PT (which is 01:00 SGT next day). Any objections?

mina: Add 20m buffer between embargo and blog so APAC desks can prepare. Suggest embargo 08:25 PT, blog 08:50 PT, swap 09:05 PT. UTMs: utm_source=partner_catalog&utm_campaign=apac_aug.

hugo: Sequence fine. I'll set Cache-Control: no-cache on the swap endpoints and issue targeted invalidation for /marketplace/* right after flip. Rollback = flip flag off.

sara: Legal action: chasing HW-X for signature now. If no sign-off by final cutover we hide tile and show "Partner coming soon". Also confirm SI badges allowed on integration pages only.

launch-bot: Dry-run allowed - recommend running 45m before final. Preflight checks: all assets present? yes/no.

alex: Owners: alex (overall), mina (press/blog/UTMs), hugo (microsite/cutover), sara (legal). Reply when your task is done. :white_check_mark:

mina: Press kit updated with UTMs + partner quotes (SI-Prime). Circulating embargo table to media.

hugo: Dry-run on staging passed. Minor CSS tweak applied. Final dry-run 30m prior.

sara: HW-X approved with hero restriction (web only) at 07:10 PT. Asset pack uploaded.

launch-bot: Reminder: maintenance window 6501239000 ahead; ensure cutover completes before window.

alex: Final checklist: 1) legal assets (sara) 2) press kit + UTMs (mina) 3) staging dry-run green (hugo) 4) on-call monitoring (eng-oncall). We'll move to #launch-room for live comms. Thanks team. :rocket:
